evidence_class: coordinator-recorded local native installation and provider-backed route integration
scope: Coupled SDK/CLI 0.160.0 installation and native-account SDK, gateway SDK and gateway CLI marker canaries on the existing host. Not new-host or model-quality acceptance.

provenance.missing_output_note: The supplied facts retain marker responses, usage and the CLI exit status, but no raw stdout/stderr hashes.

installation.compile_command:
uv pip compile blueprints/us-equities/workers/requirements.txt \
  --constraints adoption/sdk/accepted-constraints.txt \
  --python "$PYTHON_BIN" --python-version 3.13.15 \
  --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --generate-hashes --no-build \
  --no-sources --default-index https://pypi.org/simple --no-header \
  --output-file adoption/sdk/requirements-linux-x86_64-py313.lock --quiet
installation.lock_copy_note: The coordinator recompiled this lock from the repository root with the exact adoption/sdk/README.md command using uv 0.12.17. Only the openai-codex and openai-codex-cli-bin version lines and their artifact-hash lines differ from main; input-locator comments remain repository-relative. Strict-hash sync and pip check were re-run on these bytes in a fresh environment, both exit 0, and the bundled CLI SHA256 is unchanged.

usage_scope: Per-canary native last and total are the same cumulative snapshot; count total once per SDK canary. CLI gateway usage is unrecorded.
state_db_note: git diff rust-v0.159.3 rust-v0.160.0 -- codex-rs/state shows no new SQL migration files (runtime, reclamation and tests only)
limits: Coordinator-recorded native-account and gateway qualification on the existing host only; not new-host or model-quality acceptance.
Gateway backend model and effort were not read from the call log; configured/requested routes and efforts do not prove backend selection.
The shared host launcher, daemon and production prefix still run 0.159.3 until a separate coordinated switch.
The 0.159.3 queue, Hindsight and October 1 SDK receipts retain their original scope; they do not qualify 0.160.0.
No stdout/stderr hashes, SDK caller exit codes, CLI token usage, gateway backend usage or monetary cost were supplied in the qualification facts; these remain unrecorded.
SDK last and total usage snapshots match for each canary and must be counted once; cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not additional tokens.
No unchanged upstream test suite, shared daemon restart, cleanup/recovery acceptance, package signature or provenance attestation verification is recorded here.
The move is inside the seven-day cooldown recorded in docs/decisions/2026-09-25-workstation-sota-refresh.md, as the prior 0.159.2 and 0.159.3 moves were (docs/decisions/2026-09-27-model-currency.md).
This repository change records existing coordinator qualification; it performs no new model run or shared-host switch.
source_fact_correction: The first compile ran in a private directory and changed input-locator comments. The coordinator corrected this with a repository-root recompile using the README command; the new lock SHA256 is the sdk_pair.lock_sha256_repo_root_compile value in the updated qualification facts. The coordinator re-ran strict-hash sync and pip check on the new bytes in a fresh environment, both exit 0, with the bundled CLI SHA256 unchanged. The 34 other distributions retain their versions and artifact hashes. An exact comparison with the base commit 56473e4b lock (git show HEAD:adoption/sdk/requirements-linux-x86_64-py313.lock) shows two package-version lines and ten artifact-hash lines per side: 24 changed lines total, rather than 24 hash lines.
